name: ascii-effect
title: ASCII Effect
description: Renders an image as dithered ASCII characters on a canvas, with static, flowing pointer-ripple, and glitch-reveal variants.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed } from 'vue';
  import AsciiEffect from './AsciiEffect.vue';
  import { FLOW_COLORS } from './ascii-effect';
  import type { AsciiEffectPresetProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AsciiEffectPresetProps>();

  const palette = computed(() => props.colors ?? FLOW_COLORS);
</script>

<template>
  <AsciiEffect v-bind="props" variant="flow" :colors="palette" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed } from 'vue';

  import { GLITCH_COLORS } from './ascii-effect';
  import type { AsciiEffectPresetProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AsciiEffectPresetProps>();

  const palette = computed(() => props.colors ?? GLITCH_COLORS);
</script>

<template>
  <AsciiEffect v-bind="props" variant="glitch" :colors="palette" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed } from 'vue';
  import AsciiEffect from './AsciiEffect.vue';
  import { IMAGE_COLORS } from './ascii-effect';
  import type { AsciiEffectPresetProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<AsciiEffectPresetProps>();

  const palette = computed(() => props.colors ?? IMAGE_COLORS);
</script>

<template>
  <AsciiEffect v-bind="props" variant="image" :colors="palette" />
</template>
